notes: Calculated magnitude fit over measured coverage; imported phase is retained but is not corrected.
Fit error uses 512 equally log-spaced points. Predicted curves exclude the proposed common preamp.
Normalization subtracts one shared measured mean and a separate target mean over 200.0–2000.0 Hz, retaining the measured L/R level difference.
Measured and target curves use 0.16666666666666666-octave centered smoothing; stored source values are unchanged.
The total 24-band budget is split across independently fitted channels; normalization uses one shared measurement offset.
Proposed preamp uses the largest fitted L/R response plus 0.5 dB margin; it is a frequency-response estimate, not a transient or hardware clipping guarantee.
